# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")
source("../scripts/functions/nice_plots.R")
source("../scripts/functions/run_de_analysis.R")
```

```{r}
select <- dplyr::select

```

## Load data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

# PCA

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subcategory, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```
